text_block_list.text:
It's been a year since I last came here— 
the season for summer training camp has 
arrived once again.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...When we came here last year, you were 
right in the middle of your Triple Crown 
campaign.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If things had gone smoothly back then, I 
wonder if I would've set my sights on the 
Japan Cup or something.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. That is my...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It is the path of King Halo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
First, what we want to focus on training 
is speed. If you want to win the Sprinters 
Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Th-That King-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Special Week-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: U-Um... you see... Long... time no see...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...You don't need to say that. We see each 
other at the academy all the time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Yeah, you're right. You are... but 
still.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: K-King-chan! Guess what!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What race are you running in next, 
King-chan!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean...? I doubt our choices 
will overlap though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, even so! I want to know! Because I... 
King is...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chaaan? You left your things behind, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, sorry, El-chan! Right now...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...One should never keep others waiting.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: There are no "buts" about it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Let's talk again sometime. Is that okay 
with you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: You have a different vibe today.

You have a different vibe today, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
King is constantly evolving. Don't go 
assuming I'm the same as I was yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (...Hey, King-chan...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(After running all kinds of races and 
competing with everyone, I realized 
something.)

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! Who do you consider your 
rival?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: R-Rivals?! Ri-Rival... Uh, uuuuh?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not about 'who.' To me, both 
Sei-chan and King-chan are..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Everyone is—
